primary_role: Cross-embodiment aggregation and RT-X training mixture
canonical_storage_format: RLDS episode format serialized as TFRecord/TFDS datasets on GCS
observations: Per-step observation dictionaries; original modalities preserved across source datasets, including RGB cameras, depth cameras, point clouds, proprioception where available; RT-X training uses a selected canonical RGB workspace camera plus task string
actions: Original robot action spaces preserved in RLDS; RT-X coarse alignment maps actions to 7-DoF end-effector vector: x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw, gripper opening; values may be absolute, delta, or velocity depending on source robot
language_or_task_labels: Language instructions when present; RT-X model input uses task string; dataset-level taxonomy covers skills/tasks but source annotations vary
episode_metadata: RLDS episode/steps structure with boundary flags; source dataset metadata and citations in official dataset spreadsheet; download by dataset_name from gs://gdm-robotics-open-x-embodiment
robot_embodiment_metadata: 22 robot embodiments across 60 datasets; embodiment info mostly dataset-level rather than per-frame universal robot spec
camera_or_video_storage: Serialized RLDS/TFRecord stores image tensors; source datasets may include different camera counts and modalities; RT-X selects one canonical view for model input
state_action_frequency: Source-dependent; RT-X inference/examples cite roughly 3-10 Hz; paper figure shows examples at 3/5/10 Hz; no single fixed dataset FPS
license_and_download: Repository software Apache-2.0; non-software materials CC-BY per GitHub; component dataset citation/license review still needed; download via gsutil to TensorFlow Datasets directory
fact_standard_signal: RLDS is the main open cross-embodiment training-mixture standard; 7-DoF EE+gripper is the common alignment target for VLA pretraining
evidence_gaps: Per-subset license, fps, camera calibration, state field names, and robot metadata require spreadsheet/source dataset inspection before commercial use

primary_role: In-the-wild single-platform distributed data collection benchmark
canonical_storage_format: RLDS for training; raw dataset as per-episode folders with HDF5 low-dimensional trajectories plus MP4/SVO camera recordings
observations: RLDS observations include gripper_position, cartesian_position, joint_position, wrist_image_left, exterior_image_1_left, exterior_image_2_left; raw data includes full-HD stereo camera recordings and low-dimensional state/action trajectories
actions: RLDS action is 7D [6 joint velocities + 1 gripper position]; action_dict also stores gripper position/velocity, Cartesian position/velocity, joint position/velocity
language_or_task_labels: Up to three natural-language instructions per episode; original GUI task metadata; success label included in metadata/collection protocol
episode_metadata: RLDS episode_metadata has recording_folderpath and file_path; raw episode folders include metadata_*.json such as building ID and data collector ID; reward/discount/boundary flags in steps
robot_embodiment_metadata: Robot embodiment is intentionally fixed: Franka Panda 7DoF arm + Robotiq 2F-85 gripper + two Zed 2 exterior stereo cameras + wrist Zed Mini; distributed collectors use shared hardware platform
camera_or_video_storage: RLDS stores downsampled RGB images at 180x320x3 for three left camera views; raw data stores MP4 high-res single/stereo video and ZED SVO recordings
state_action_frequency: 15 Hz control frequency for actions/state; camera streams synchronized; dataset totals 76k successful demos/350h
license_and_download: Dataset CC-BY 4.0; RLDS GCS bucket about 1.7TB; raw stereo MP4 about 8.7TB; non-stereo raw about 5.6TB
fact_standard_signal: DROID shows that industrializable data collection needs fixed hardware kits, calibration protocol, per-episode metadata, multiple language labels, and raw+training-ready dual release
evidence_gaps: Official docs expose schema but not all raw metadata keys; 20% raw face-blurred upload note should be rechecked before relying on raw completeness

primary_role: China-origin multi-embodiment manipulation dataset and benchmark
canonical_storage_format: Per-trajectory HDF5 under embodiment/task/success/train-val folders; public gated Hugging Face plus project GitHub docs; some community LeRobot conversions exist but are not canonical
observations: HDF5 observations group with rgb_images and depth_images; camera sets depend on embodiment: e.g. Franka top/left/right, AgileX front/left_wrist/right_wrist, UR top, Tien Kung top; proprioception includes joint positions, end-effector pose, joint effort/velocity for some embodiments
actions: Actions inferred from puppet/master groups and robomind.yaml controls; examples include joint_position, joint_position_left/right, end_effector; dimensionality varies by embodiment: Franka/UR single-arm, AgileX dual-arm, Tien Kung humanoid/dexterous-hand variants
language_or_task_labels: Task-level language instruction CSV; frame-level fine-grained language description annotations updated in v1.2; paper reports 10k successful trajectories with refined segment annotations
episode_metadata: Directory encodes embodiment/task/success/train-val; HDF5 trajectory length; failure demonstrations include detailed causes per paper, but exact public file schema for failures is partly gated
robot_embodiment_metadata: Four primary embodiments in paper: Franka Emika Panda, UR5e, AgileX dual-arm robot, humanoid robot with dual dexterous hands; README gives trajectory counts and embodiment-specific config in robomind.yaml
camera_or_video_storage: Images are stored as HDF5 object datasets under observations/rgb_images and observations/depth_images; some embodiments BGR not RGB; intrinsics released separately
state_action_frequency: Real-world frequency not clearly normalized in public docs; simulation notes state robot state sampled at about 4x camera frame rate; frame counts vary by episode/embodiment
license_and_download: Hugging Face dataset card lists Apache-2.0 but gated access requires sharing contact information; download through HF/Beaicloud/ModelScope links depending version
fact_standard_signal: RoboMIND demonstrates embodiment-specific HDF5 schemas plus a config file mapping camera names, action keys, state keys, and color order; failure data and segment language are important differentiators
evidence_gaps: Need validate current v2.0 ModelScope schema, exact real-world fps, failure-label file layout, and commercial-use implications of gated terms

primary_role: Large-scale enterprise-grade long-horizon dual-arm/humanoid data platform
canonical_storage_format: LeRobot-compatible layout on Hugging Face/ModelScope; Parquet episode data, MP4 camera streams, JSON/JSONL metadata; original long-horizon format plus split-to-standard-LeRobot script
observations: Required features include observation.state and observation.images.*; official README lists camera keys such as top_head, hand_left, hand_right, head_depth, head fisheye/stereo streams; paper states image observations plus proprioceptive joint/end-effector positions
actions: Required action vector in Parquet; field_descriptions define flattened dimensions/indices; examples include action/joint/position and action/robot/velocity
language_or_task_labels: tasks.jsonl stores high-level task labels; info.json adds key_frame and instruction_segments for subtask, skill, error/success/intervention, object bbox, and step-level instructions
episode_metadata: episodes.jsonl stores episode_index, tasks, length; info.json stores schema/path templates/video metadata/custom annotations; annotations.json optionally keeps raw labels/review/source paths
robot_embodiment_metadata: Collected on AGIBOT G2 platform for 2026 release; paper states modular end effectors including gripper, dexterous hand, visuo-tactile gripper; eight-camera system; five deployment domains
camera_or_video_storage: Each video file stores one camera stream for one episode in MP4; camera features are observation.images.* with video type, frame rate, codec, pixel format, shape; Parquet stores state/action values
state_action_frequency: Paper reports image observations and proprioceptive states/actions recorded at 30 Hz control frequency
license_and_download: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for data/code in HF repo; git-lfs/sparse checkout; sample dataset about 7GB; full repo via HF/ModelScope
fact_standard_signal: AgiBot extends LeRobot with long-horizon hierarchical annotations, failure/intervention frames, object grounding, and split-to-single-instruction conversion; this is close to a production data-factory schema
evidence_gaps: Need verify full public dataset size versus paper's 1M+ Colosseo claim, exact G2 action vector dimensions per task, tactile fields availability, and whether all annotations are present for all tasks

primary_role: Open-source robot learning library and interchange dataset format
canonical_storage_format: LeRobotDataset v3: tabular low-dimensional data in Apache Parquet, camera frames in MP4 or images, metadata in JSON/Parquet; Hub-native streaming
observations: Public API returns observation.state tensors and observation.images.<camera> tensors; custom robot datasets define feature names/dtypes/shapes in meta/info.json
actions: Action tensor under action; action dimensionality and semantics are dataset-specific but declared in features/stats; supports temporal windows via delta_timestamps
language_or_task_labels: meta/tasks.jsonl maps natural-language task descriptions to task IDs; samples include task_index; recording CLI supports --dataset.single_task
episode_metadata: meta/info.json defines schema, fps, codebase version, path templates; meta/stats.json stores normalization stats; meta/episodes stores episode boundaries/lengths/offsets; frame rows include timestamp, frame_index, episode_index, index, task_index
robot_embodiment_metadata: info.json has robot_type and feature schema; hardware-specific details live in dataset metadata/Robot class, not a universal robot ontology
camera_or_video_storage: v3 concatenates frames from multiple episodes into larger MP4 shards per camera; paths resolved through video_path template; data/ Parquet shards may contain many episodes
state_action_frequency: No global fixed frequency; fps is declared per dataset in meta/info.json; recording examples commonly configure camera fps such as 30
license_and_download: LeRobot software Apache-2.0; each dataset on HF has its own license; download/stream through Hugging Face Hub or local files
fact_standard_signal: LeRobot v3 is the strongest candidate for practical interchange: Parquet+MP4+metadata, Hub streaming, task metadata, normalization stats, and broad PyTorch training integration
evidence_gaps: Robot embodiment metadata is not yet as rich as needed for industrial cross-embodiment datasets: URDF, calibration, control mode, safety/provenance should be added by platform conventions
